angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 11,055,369 km at 20.18 pc = 7.32 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 9884: distance 20.178 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.005), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 20.178 +/- 0.101 pc; Gaia DR3 cannot see the star
radiusSource: Radius 15.891 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 9884: radius 15.891 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 88.089 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.057) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 11,055,369 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4439 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 9884: effective temperature 4439 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.093) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 9884: effective temperature 4439 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.093) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433)
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of alf Ari (pscomppars): spectral type K2III, from Turnbull 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015arXiv151001731T/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of alf Ari (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.09 dex, from Lee et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011A%26A...529A.134L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of alf Ari (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 1.934, from Turnbull 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015arXiv151001731T/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of alf Ari (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.1 km/s, from Lee et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011A%26A...529A.134L/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's measured spectrum (Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1)) (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.

surfaceGravitySource: log g 2.4 from 2025A&A...698A..93J; the 33 published values span log g 1.38 to 2.85, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.3% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A%26A...698A..93J)
